titleZh: 雲海景觀旗艦尊爵套房
subtitleZh: 270度環景山巒雲海・全景景觀石造浴缸
subtitleEn: 270° Panoramic Mountain Vistas & Stone Soaking Tub
bedTypeZh: 特大雙人床 (King Size) x 2 + 日式榻榻米加床區
highlightsZh: 270度超大落地觀景窗，破曉時分直面雲海日出
獨立景觀陽台與躺椅休憩區
雙人深浸式石造天然景觀浴池
Dyson 吹風機與頂級茶籽堂沐浴備品
Marshall 復古藍牙音響
highlightsEn: 270-degree floor-to-ceiling glass wall facing sunrise and mist
Private outdoor balcony with panoramic loungers
Deep-soak natural stone scenic bath
Dyson Supersonic hairdryer & Cha Tzu Tang amenities
Marshall Bluetooth acoustic speaker
descZh: 山莊最頂級的旗艦之作，晨起時分薄霧繚繞，推開落地窗即可俯瞰綿延千里的雲海山嵐。房內設有專屬景觀泡湯池，在沉浸於溫暖泉水時，盡覽星辰與山谷暮色。
descEn: The crown jewel of Shan Yu Villa. Marvel at rolling sea of clouds at dawn through floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass. Features a private stone soaking tub overlooking the tranquil forest.

highlightsEn: Exclusive private access to Japanese Zen rock garden
Private dual outdoor stone thermal bath
Handcrafted solid wood tea ceremony set with premium tea
Independent inverter climate control system
Luxury orthopaedic pocket spring mattress
descZh: 以東方寂靜美學為設計核心，連結專屬私人日式庭園，綠竹微風搖曳。在石造風呂中享受私密放鬆時光，體驗歲月靜好的深層療癒。
descEn: Designed with oriental wabi-sabi aesthetics, connected directly to a private zen bamboo garden. Unwind in your private stone bath amid gentle forest breezes.

descEn: Perched on the top floor with pristine starry views free of light pollution. Features a 100-inch 4K home theater system, making it the favorite for families and friends.

descZh: 沉穩溫潤的黑胡桃原木質調，窗外即是蒼翠林相。空氣中瀰漫著淡淡木香與山間芬多精，提供最純粹寧靜的深層睡眠體驗。
descEn: Embraced by towering mountain woods, featuring natural walnut textures and serene woodland vistas. The gentle fragrance of timber ensures deep, restorative sleep.
